Dear Tanisha,

Thank you for applying for the AI Engineer Intern position at TechNova Solutions.

We are pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted for the next round of the selection process. Your technical interview is scheduled for **Thursday, September 10 at 3:00 PM** and will be conducted online via Google Meet.

The interview will focus on Python, machine learning fundamentals, LLMs, and your previous projects.

Please confirm your availability by replying to this email. If you are unable to attend at the scheduled time, let us know and we can discuss an alternative slot.

Best regards,
Priya Sharma
Talent Acquisition Team
TechNova Solutions
